data.title: 优香 · 核账之后的可可
data.description: 【优香 · 核账之后的可可】最后一张收据终于归好类，优香穿着淡蓝色宽松毛衣和居家短裤坐在宿舍小桌旁，红框眼镜下的眉头放松下来。她用双手捧起温热的可可杯，闭上的账本留在桌角——「今天就到这里。喝完这一杯，我也该好好休息了。」
data.action: 坐在小桌旁，双手捧着可可杯，闭合的账本放在桌角
data.promptProse: After finishing her accounts, Yuuka sits beside her dormitory table in a pastel-blue knit sweater and house slippers, her red-framed glasses in place as she holds a warm cocoa mug in both hands. A small bedside lamp casts an amber circle over the closed ledger and sorted receipts, while steam rises in front of her relieved smile.
data.camera: medium shot, cocoa mug in both hands and closed ledger beside her
data.lighting: 床头小灯照亮杯口热气的暖光
